desc: Designed for premium performance and convenience, this 24" Bosch dishwasher features patented CrystalDry™ technology that transforms moisture into heat, delivering up to 60% drier dishes, including plastics. Operating at an ultra-quiet 42 dBA, it uses InfoLight® to project a subtle beam on the floor so you know it’s running.
hl: Enhance your cleaning experience with Wi-Fi enabled Home Connect®
Smart Cycle takes the guesswork out of cycle selection by quickly helping you identify and save the best program combination for your needs.
Every dishwasher must pass 485 quality checks--including running every single one with water--before leaving the factory.
Fit in tall items with RackMatic®
RackMatic® easily adjusts to three different heights and up to nine separate rack positions, allowing taller items like stemware to fit in the middle rack while leaving room for pots and pans below.
Sleek and Simple Touch Control Panel
The touch control panel has been simplified to offer the cycles and options you use most - all at the touch of your fingertips.
